# Agy Diff **3-Scope Shiki Diff Viewer, Turn Rewind Time-Machine, Tree-sitter AST Call-Impact Analyzer & One-Click External IDE Jumper for Google Antigravity** [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE) [![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/Platform-macOS%20%7C%20Linux%20%7C%20Windows-lightgrey.svg)](#supported-editors--cross-platform-support) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Sidecar%20Plugin-6366f1.svg)](https://antigravity.google/docs/plugins) English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)
--- ## Why Agy Diff? When working with AI coding agents in **Antigravity**, reviewing what just changed and jumping straight to the exact function or line in your preferred editor (VS Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Zed, IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, GoLand, RustRover, etc.) should take **one click**—without losing context in a narrow side pane. **Agy Diff** embeds a lightweight, high-contrast diff & symbol panel right inside Antigravity's Auxiliary Pane: - **3 Change Scopes**: Instantly switch between **Current Turn (`本轮改动`)** (exact edits from the agent's latest or any past turn), **This Session (`本次对话`)** (all files edited in this conversation—including already-committed changes), and **Git Changes (`Git 变更`)** (full working-tree & staged diff). - **VS Code-Grade Dual-Theme Syntax Highlighting**: Powered by **Shiki** (TextMate engine, `github-light-default` & `github-dark-default`) across **19 languages**, auto-synced with Antigravity's light/dark theme. Old (`-`) and new (`+`) sides are highlighted independently so unclosed multi-line comments or template strings never bleed across diff lines. - **Inline Tree-sitter AST Method Headers & Call-Impact Analysis**: - Extracts changed functions, methods, constructors, decorators, React `memo`/`forwardRef` components, class arrow fields, and Go generic receivers across **8 WASM grammars** and places them inline on each diff hunk header—plus automatic **inline method dividers** when a single hunk spans adjacent functions. - Click **`影响` (Impact)** on any changed function to inspect **who calls it across the workspace**: powered by `git grep` + Tree-sitter AST filtering (eliminating comment/string false positives), resolving each caller's enclosing method, separating business vs. test coverage, jumping directly to any caller in your IDE, or attaching the impact checklist straight to Agy to add missing tests. - **Turn Rewind Time-Machine (1-Click Undo Safety Net)**: - A `PreToolUse` hook captures deduplicated, content-addressed pre-edit snapshots right before Agent mutations (with safe exact reverse-patch fallback for older turns and Git `HEAD` restore for working-tree files). - Rewind an **entire Agent turn** or any **single file** with inline confirmation, automatic pre-rewind Undo backups (`撤销回滚`), and one-click `告知 Agy` attachment to ask the agent to try a different approach. - **One-Click Jump, Native IDE Diff & Agy Integration**: - Click any line number or inline `ƒ method()` header to jump directly to `file:line:col` in your editor. - Launch native side-by-side diffs (`code --diff`, `cursor --diff`, `idea diff`, `zed --diff`, etc.) including new, renamed, and deleted files. - Open Antigravity's built-in file preview (`预览`) or attach inline line/method review comments (`+`) straight to your next Agy message. - **Built for Narrow Side Panes (~380px)**: Single-line file headers (`Filename dir +14 -3 ↗`) with zero-reflow hover actions, sticky left gutters, full CJK/Pinyin IME search support, and zero-layout-shift floating notifications. --- ## Screenshots

   

--- ## Installation ### Option 1: Install Directly from GitHub (Recommended) Because the repository ships a pre-built, self-contained `sidecars/diff_panel` bundle alongside `plugin.json` and `hooks.json`, end users need **zero build steps**: ```bash agy plugin install https://github.com/linannn/agy-diff ``` Then open **Agy Diff** from Antigravity's right-hand Side Panel (`Plugins → Agy Diff`). ### Option 2: Install from a Local Clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/linannn/agy-diff.git cd agy-diff agy plugin install . ``` Or build from source and install into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/agy-diff`: ```bash npm install npm run install-plugin ``` --- ## Supported Editors & Cross-Platform Support Agy Diff automatically detects installed and currently running editors on your machine, recommends the best match per repository ecosystem (and remembers your per-workspace choice), and shows **only editors you actually have installed**. | Editor | Jump (`file:line:col`) | Native Side-by-Side Diff | macOS | Linux | Windows | | --- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | **VS Code** (`code`) | `--goto` / `vscode://` | `code --diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Cursor** (`cursor`) | `--goto` / `cursor://` | `cursor --diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Windsurf** (`windsurf`) | `--goto` / `windsurf://` | `windsurf --diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Zed** (`zed`) | `path:line:col` / `zed://` | `zed --diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **IntelliJ IDEA** (`idea`) | `--line --column` / `idea://` | `idea diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **WebStorm / PyCharm / GoLand / CLion / RustRover / Rider** | `--line --column` / URL | ` diff` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Sublime Text** (`subl`) | `path:line:col` | — | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | | **Custom IDE Template** (Neovide, Emacs, etc.) | `{{filename}} {{line}} {{column}}` | `{{oldFile}} {{newFile}}` | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | > **JetBrains multi-project note**: When a JetBrains IDE is detected, Settings offers a 3-way strategy (`Auto` / `Always` / `File only`) to prevent opening unwanted new windows or LightEdit mode. > > **Bilingual UI (English & Chinese)**: Automatically adapts to your browser/system locale (`Auto` / `English` / `中文`) with instant live switching inside Settings. --- ## Supported Languages - **Tree-sitter WASM AST (Inline Method Headers & Outlines)**: TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, JSX, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust. - **Shiki Syntax Highlighting (19 Languages)**: TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, JSX, Vue, Python, Java, Kotlin, Go, Rust, HTML, CSS, SCSS, JSON, YAML, SQL, Bash, Markdown, XML. --- ## Security & Privacy - **100% Local**: No telemetry, no external network calls—all Git inspection, AST parsing, and Shiki highlighting run locally inside the Antigravity Sidecar process. - **Strict Path Containment**: All file diff, jump, and native diff APIs enforce canonical path boundary checks (`realpathSync.native`), rejecting directory traversal (`../`) and external symlink escapes. - **Injection-Safe Command Builder**: Built-in editors spawn directly without a shell; custom command templates tokenize quotes/whitespace *before* `{{var}}` substitution so filenames with spaces or quotes can never inject CLI flags. - **Hardened Frontend & State**: Strict CSP (`default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'`), atomic `0600` writes for `prefs.json` and hook state, and explicit `--no-ext-diff --no-textconv --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/` Git flags. --- ## Development ```bash npm install npm test # Self-contained isolated test suite (zero host IDE or repo state assumptions) npm run build # Rebuilds sidecars/diff_panel/ and syncs plugin.json version npm run validate # Runs `agy plugin validate --strict .` npm run install-plugin ``` ## License [MIT](./LICENSE)

## What's New in v2.0.0

### ⏪ Turn Rewind Time-Machine (1-Click Undo Safety Net)
- Added a `PreToolUse` hook that captures deduplicated, content-addressed pre-edit snapshots (append-only JSONL + SHA-256 blobs) right before Agent edits.
- Rewind an **entire Agent turn** (`Rewind` / `回滚本轮`) or any **single file** (`↺`) with inline confirmation, safe reverse-patch fallback for older turns, Git `HEAD` restore (including staged additions & renames), and **1-click Undo** with post-rewind divergence protection so intervening user edits are never overwritten.
- One-click **Tell Agy** (`告知 Agy`) attaches a concise rewind summary to your next Antigravity message.

### ⚡ Inline Tree-sitter AST Call-Impact Analysis
- Click **Impact** (`影响`) on any changed function/method header or outline row to inspect who calls it across the workspace.
- Combines fast `git grep` discovery with bundled **8-language Tree-sitter WASM** semantic filtering (eliminating comment, string, definition, parameter, and non-callee false positives; supporting template literals, Python f-strings, Kotlin `${...}`, `$`-prefixed identifiers, and JSX member components).
- Resolves each caller's enclosing function name, separates **business vs. test coverage** (with dedicated test-file candidate quota), jumps straight to any caller line in your IDE, and offers one-click **Send to Agy** (`发给 Agy`) to add missing tests.

### 🌐 Bilingual UI (English & Simplified Chinese)
- Automatically matches your system/browser locale (`Auto` / `English` / `中文`) with instant live preview and persistent switching in **Settings**.

### Install / Upgrade
```bash
agy plugin install https://github.com/linannn/agy-diff
```
